ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) distal regions to low-intensity (black) medial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels dominate the lateral lobes; low-intensity pixels form a concentrated triangular wedge in the central region originating from the peduncle, with fine-grained dark stippling/mottling at the transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle and a depth approximately 1/8th of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; right lobe (viewer perspective) displays higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, low-intensity circular clusters scattered across the white distal regions, particularly near the tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel linear rake marks (3-4 distinct lines) on the left lobe near the central dark plume; single prominent diagonal linear disruption on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on both lobes, consistent with odontocete interaction scarring.
